purpose: one normal retained positive video ANPR acceptance run after separate approval
expected_processors: video metadata and source-time frame sampling
Roman-Urdu derivative only when an Urdu-script transcript segment exists

expected_sampling.anpr: one-second cadence, default maximum 60 frames, hard maximum 120; longer videos widen the interval
expected_sampling.secondary_roles: five-second cadence over the ANPR-sampled frame stream

ground_truth_review_truth.historical_index_timing: LN15ZZC at relabeled 25 seconds is historical and superseded as an exact source-time claim
ground_truth_review_truth.review_blocker: The benchmark preserved reconstructable crop locators but not crop bytes; Windows has no approved local decoder and browser local-file access is blocked. Do not treat OCR confidence as human confirmation.

known_limitations: Pakistan plate OCR accuracy is not certified
grouping means equal normalized OCR observations, not tracking or identity
model-dependent OCR, face, ASR and Roman-Urdu observation counts cannot be predicted exactly without executing the authorized retained job
ownership and retention authority must be attested before upload

expected_after_one_normal_upload.canonical_records: 22207 + N_raw_anpr_observations; current non-retained ANPR benchmark predicts N_raw_anpr_observations=4
expected_after_one_normal_upload.artifact_delta_formula: 82 + N_asr_segments + N_general_ocr_lines + N_face_observations + N_roman_urdu_segments, assuming 60 frame observations, 12 successful embeddings, 4 raw ANPR observations and 4 plate-group observations
expected_after_one_normal_upload.artifact_delta_exactness: MODEL_DEPENDENT_RECONCILE_AFTER_AUTHORIZED_JOB; no honest exact scalar is available without executing the current full pipeline

expected_temporary_data.cleanup: sampled frames and embedded-audio derivative removed by worker finally blocks; verify zero leaks after the job
